# π = π — Pi fungibility proof

> Source-verified, dependency-free, read-only proof that **Pi Network's native asset (π) is fungible**:
> a native Pi payment carries **no observable per-unit mining origin** on the Pi Mainnet ledger.
> Mined π = π withdrawn from an exchange (OKX / Bitget) = π sent from inside a Pi Browser app.

- Repository: https://github.com/aybvip/pi-fungibility
- Website: https://aybvip.github.io/pi-fungibility/
- License: MIT

## Canonical claim

> **“A native Pi payment carries no observable per-unit mining origin on the Pi Mainnet ledger.”**

## Scope (three separate claims)

- **A — Fungibility:** proven (deterministic, reproducible).
- **B — A specific deposit is native on-chain:** verifiable per case.
- **C — Reserve backing:** **not** claimed.

## Question-specific answers

- [Can’t you just follow the transactions and see which π came from where?](https://github.com/aybvip/pi-fungibility/blob/main/docs/FAQ-TRANSACTION-VS-COIN.md) — you can trace the *transaction*, never the *coin* (three levels)
- [Every micro-π has an ID?](https://github.com/aybvip/pi-fungibility/blob/main/docs/FAQ-MICRO-PI-ID.md) — Account/Balance model, not UTXO
- [Exchanges use M, not G?](https://github.com/aybvip/pi-fungibility/blob/main/docs/FAQ-MUXED-M-VS-G.md) — muxed accounts identify the counterparty
- [Does the SDK / Platform API expose the origin?](https://github.com/aybvip/pi-fungibility/blob/main/docs/FAQ-SDK-PLATFORM-API-FIELDS.md) — no; full field enumeration
- [Do Soroban smart contracts / ecosystem tokens change fungibility?](https://github.com/aybvip/pi-fungibility/blob/main/docs/FAQ-SMART-CONTRACTS-AND-TOKENS.md) — no; scalars only, tokens are a different asset
- [Mined + bought then sent — can the recipient tell?](https://github.com/aybvip/pi-fungibility/blob/main/docs/FAQ-RECIPIENT-CANNOT-TELL.md) — no
- [All other objections](https://github.com/aybvip/pi-fungibility/blob/main/docs/FAQ-ALL-OBJECTIONS.md) — catalogued with a refutation each

## Reproduce (Node 18+, zero dependencies, read-only)

```
node examples/run-all.mjs            # everything at once (+ summary); add --offline to skip network checks
node examples/provenance-check.mjs   # live on-chain: there is no origin field
node examples/coin-id-check.mjs      # the balance is one scalar — no per-unit ID
node examples/verify-deposit.mjs <TXID> [TO_ADDRESS]
```

## Status

- **Last verified: 2026-10-18** — all checks pass locally and in CI (Node 20/22), including live read-only Mainnet reads.
  See [VERIFICATION](https://github.com/aybvip/pi-fungibility/blob/main/docs/VERIFICATION.md).
- **Not independently audited** — self-verified and reproducible, which is not the same as a third-party audit.
  See [AUDIT-REQUEST](https://github.com/aybvip/pi-fungibility/blob/main/docs/AUDIT-REQUEST.md).
- Independent & unofficial: not affiliated with Pi Network.
